summary: No advisory committee (ODAC) meeting was convened for the GAZYVA (obinutuzumab) BLA. The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Office/Division Director memo all independently state that no committee was held because the Division had experience with the product type, trial design, and clinical endpoints, and the application raised no controversial efficacy or safety issues. With no committee held, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
